headers.comment: Firebase Hosting defaults to max-age=3600 for these, so a deploy took up to an hour to reach anyone - including the iOS shell, whose whole point is that web releases show up without a new build. Filenames here are not content-hashed, so the only safe way to guarantee freshness is to revalidate on every load; the responses are small and almost always come back as a 304.
Images are stable, so they can be cached hard.
